messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- On 2025-12-17, Team Dune decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. [decision; valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- Reindex jobs will page on failure. [decision; valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2025-11-06, Team Dune reported that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2025-11-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-06]
- On 2026-02-12, the Ember team reported that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- The scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27-2]
    earlier: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19]
- On 2026-01-01, Team Cinder noticed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-01]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2025-12-08, the pager for the indexer rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
- The indexer's incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk, leaving stale results for two days. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The reporting service can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-02-25 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-25]
- On 2025-06-23, Team Cinder observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2025-06-23 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-06-23]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]

Question: When can search-indexer be deployed?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: "When can search-indexer be deployed?"

Looking through the memory for deployment constraints related to the indexer (search-indexer):

- The scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC — that's the scheduler, not the indexer.
- The catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC — catalog service, not indexer.
- The reporting service can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC — reporting service.
- The ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays — ledger.

There is no deployment constraint mentioned for the indexer itself. There's a mention that the indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 (a pin, not a deploy window), and decisions about nightly rebuilds and paging on failure.

So the memory does not contain the answer. Reply exactly: I don't know
